scope: Read-only source and metadata inventory for a future Research7 execution guide; no worlds, policy episodes, fitting, empirical replay, or hour-scale batch runs were performed for this inventory.

authoritative_planning_artifacts.execution_guide_interpretation: The plan and test specification describe intended future phases and gates. They do not authorize or register those phases.

registration_requirements: seed_freshness_certified=true and hash-matched closed freshness evidence for the exact ordered seed list
authorized_scope equals stage_id and names one of P1_smoke, P2_train, P2_validation, P2a_pilot, P3_screen, P4_replication, P5_selection, P6_confirmation
registration design digest, all source hashes, governing simulator hashes, asset hashes, and dependency versions match
complete exact seed x family x policy cell cross-product with canonical cell identities
one complete mac-01 shard, bounded resource caps, at least 30 GiB free reserve, and hash-bound independent approval for the exact design
preserve authoritative attempts and commits; stop on interrupted attempts, conflicts, or exhausted budget
implemented_7b_execution_surface.trusted_inprocess_scope: P1_smoke only, and policy IDs G, N, R, P, K, Q6 only
implemented_7b_execution_surface.subprocess_json: A runner branch exists, but restricted-container admission and production-container certification are not implemented by the inspected runtime.
implemented_7b_execution_surface.completed_smoke_stage_clis: The generic registered coordinator CLI exists; no separate approved command or frozen registration for P2 through P6 was identified in the inspected artifacts.
implemented_7b_execution_surface.no_fake_commands: Future stage commands are intentionally left unspecified here; use only a later reviewed registration and documented implementation, not guessed CLI invocations.

smoke_resource_observations.qualification: These are recorded averages for the six-reference P1 smoke implementation and its output format. They are not estimates or guarantees for candidate policies, fitting, future stages, physical retries, or changed logging. The max worker RSS is the largest observed worker peak, not a forecast.

planned_episode_arithmetic.scope_note: Distinct cells in the listed grids; plan.json says physical verification replays and retries are additional attempts and consume finite budgets, never independent samples.

mechanical_reference_only_projection.formula: planned distinct episode ceiling multiplied by observed mean six-reference P1 smoke per-attempt resource average
mechanical_reference_only_projection.label: static arithmetic scenario, not a future candidate runtime forecast or feasibility certification

planned_budgets_and_batches.batch_guidance: The inspected plan sets aggregate caps and requires profiling actual work, but the evidence inspected here does not define a future episode-count batch size or candidate runtime. Derive each batch from an independently reviewed stage registration, candidate-specific measured cost, 1.5x forecast headroom, retry/replay allowance, and free-space reserve. Recalculate after each finite batch; stop at any budget or validity gate. The smoke-average arithmetic above is not a sizing basis for candidate episodes.

disk_free_snapshot.qualification: Point-in-time filesystem snapshot; not reserved capacity or guaranteed free space for a future batch.

cleanup_prior.interpretation: Historical cleanup record only; the current df snapshot is the current capacity evidence.

7a_exact_review_receipt.scope: Finite declared reduced-model oracle, not deployed or full official-protocol validation
remaining_gates: for broader D2 admission, dominance mapping or explicit official query action aliases

requirements_include: exact reduced-model and policy agreement tests
research7_methodology_gates_referenced.requirement_state: Planning requirements unless independently evidenced in a later stage registration and completed review.
